name: Kagesaki Hiroyuki
source:
A childhood friend of Manatsu and Fuyuka who lives next door to the Hidaka family. Because their parents are both working, the accompanies the Hidaka family on a trip.

Since Arisa and Takeshi have no sons, they have always been fond of him.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/kk/character.html#Chara08]Official website[/url]]
